page.overview:
Who is Daniel Espinoza?

Daniel Espinoza is a Hispanic American CIA Agent sent to infiltrate the drug cartel of Gabriel Cazares who had taken over Isla Nublar by 2011. However, Espinoza was found out and then released into the jungle to be killed by either the dinosaurs or by Cazares' right hand man hunting him down. Espinoza fought back against the Cartel and worked alongside Frances White, an animal behaviorist who had lived amongst Velociraptors for almost twenty years.

Espinoza served as the main protagonist of the non canon IDW Publishing comic book series Jurassic Park: Dangerous Games.

Daniel Espinoza was an American of Hispanic heritage who in his adult life became an agent of the CIA. He operated in Latin American countries in order to investigate drug cartels which supplied various illegal drugs through the countries up into the United States. Three months prior to the events of the comic, Daniel arrived in Nicaragua with a female partner in the CIA to inform her on what he uncovered about Gabriel Cazares, a notorious Nicaraguan drug lord.

He revealed the names of Cazares' Mexican contacts but didn't know where the location of the fields where the drugs were grown. The woman revealed that Cazares had recently purchased Isla Nublar from the Costa Rican government. As the island was meant to be a sanctuary for the dinosaurs after the San Diego Incident, they suspected that Cazares paid someone off in the United Nations to allow the purchase. Espinoza revealed The two bid farewell as Espinoza headed off for his mission.
